info.title: Grok Desk Entitlement API
info.description: Authoritative entitlement, activation, lease, portal, download, and release contracts for Grok Desk. Error bodies are always { code, message, requestId } without raw details.

tags.name: internal
tags.description: Landing-service endpoints protected by rotating internal HMAC

post.description: Public migration path for desktop clients. Obtain a challenge from /v1/activations/challenges, sign the standard GROKDESK-ACTIVATE-V1 device proof, and submit it with the GD2 bearer. Internal HMAC credentials are never used by the client.

internalHmac.name: x-grokdesk-signature
internalHmac.description: Rotating HMAC over GROKDESK-INTERNAL-V1 canonical bytes. Also requires x-grokdesk-key-id, x-grokdesk-timestamp, and x-grokdesk-nonce for mutations.

code.description: Stable error code. Public clients must only branch on known codes.

message.description: Safe human-readable message without raw internal details.

PublicLegacyGd2ExchangeRequest.description: Proof-bound GD2 migration request. gd2 proves purchase ownership; the remaining fields are the standard activation device proof.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the normal GROKDESK-ACTIVATE-V1 payload for the supplied challenge and device

alreadyExchanged.description: True when the legacy allowlist exchange had already been recorded

LegacyGd2ExchangeRequest.description: Submit a legacy GD2 key for allowlist fingerprint exchange. Raw key is hashed server-side and never stored. GD1/H1 always rejected. Closed after LEGACY_GD2_EXCHANGE_SUNSET.

activationRequired.description: Always true — device must still complete activation after exchange

alreadyExchanged.description: True when the allowlist row was already marked exchanged (idempotent replay)

StableErrorCode.description: invalid_key_format: Product key format is invalid; invalid_key_signature: Product key signature is invalid; key_rotated: Product key has been rotated; entitlement_suspended: Entitlement is suspended; entitlement_refunded: Entitlement has been refunded; entitlement_revoked: Entitlement has been revoked; seat_limit: All device seats are in use; challenge_expired: Challenge has expired; challenge_replayed: Challenge has already been used; device_signature_invalid: Device signature is invalid; clock_skew: Client clock is too far from server time; unsupported_client: Client version is not supported; unsupported_architecture: Architecture is not supported; device_deactivated: Device has been deactivated; lease_expired: Device lease has expired; lease_device_mismatch: Lease is not bound to this device; grant_expired: Download grant has expired; grant_used: Download grant has already been used; grant_binding_mismatch: Download grant binding mismatch; legacy_key_unsupported: This legacy key type cannot be exchanged; use recovery or support; legacy_key_not_allowlisted: Legacy key is not eligible for automatic exchange; legacy_exchange_closed: Legacy key exchange window has closed; fulfillment_pending: Purchase fulfillment is still processing; service_unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable
